name: computes the one-pass traffic ratio for rectangular matrices
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(matmul_arithmetic_intensity(2, 3, 4), 6 / 13, rel_tol=1e-12)
assert isinstance(matmul_arithmetic_intensity(2, 3, 4), float)

name: handles a vector-like multiply and a non-default element width
test:
import math
assert math.isclose(matmul_arithmetic_intensity(1, 1, 16, element_bytes=8), 4 / 33, rel_tol=1e-12)
assert math.isclose(matmul_arithmetic_intensity(8, 8, 8), 4 / 3, rel_tol=1e-12)

name: rejects booleans, non-integers, and non-positive dimensions
input: a boolean dimension, a float dimension, and zero byte width
